selection: On8 previous development texts, aggregate both seeds: candidate must improve spoken word-edit count by >=2, not worsen spoken CER or repeated trigram excess. Then minimum word edits, character edits, closest amplitude to1. Baseline included. No fresh result selects amplitude.
reference_scope: Official CLI exposes temperature and defaults to.667; this is motivation, not evidence that.667 improves this own model.
limits: Development reused from prior diagnostic;8 fresh texts and2 seeds are still a small sample. Less noise may flatten prosody. No accent or naturalness validation, no new pretrained weights.
